sections.title: LIC vs. Private Insurers: Premium & Feature Comparison

content.text: LIC’s term plans are backed by the corporation’s nationwide network and long track record. For buyers who value offline support, brand recognition, and standardized processes, LIC remains a strong choice — and it now offers online-only plans (Tech-Term, Digi Term) for better pricing and convenience.

We used live premium examples from market aggregators (PolicyBazaar, PolicyX) for common scenarios (₹50L/₹1Cr, ages 25/30/35, smoker/non-smoker). Use the calculator above to get an exact quote for your profile — premiums differ widely by age and product.
